# 更好的表情 *那双美丽的眼睛……* [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&color=black)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/bare-bones-better-beaves) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&color=black)](https://modrinth.com/organization/cre8to-team) [![Feedback](https://img.shields.io/badge/feedback%20form%20(no%20login)-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=googleforms&color=indigo)](https://forms.gle/fkgMp6YroGjwH8Nr5) [![Donate@CupOfCoffee](https://img.shields.io/badge/donate%20a%20cup%20of%20coffee-0?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon&color=black)](https://patreon.com/cre8to) **這項功能得益於 [Just Expressions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/just-expressions) 與 [Better Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/better-animations) 的精彩合作，成功將動態眼睛帶入 Better Animations 模型中！** ![AboutThePack](https://img.shields.io/badge/-About%20this%20pack-darkblue?style=for-the-badge) 徹底翻新你的 Minecraft 玩家動畫，讓它們栩栩如生！ 與幾乎所有動畫模組相容！包含 Better Combat、Quark、Emotecraft 表情動作以及 Parcool！ 同時支援 **Fabric** 與 **Forge** **本資源包 v11.0 及以上版本需搭配 EMF v2.1.0 或更高版本** ![Installation](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Installation-navy?style=for-the-badge) 從 Releases 標籤頁下載最新的 Better_Expressions.zip。 從 ![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Dependencies-navy?style=for-the-badge) 標籤頁下載所需模組。 將模組與資源包放置於對應資料夾中。 在遊戲內的「資源包」標籤頁中啟用該資源包。 ![Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Dependencies-navy?style=for-the-badge) Fabric API：https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api Entity Model Features：https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features Entity Texture Features：https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures ![Credits](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Credits-navy?style=for-the-badge) MincraftEinstein, Prairies, XyperCode, Mysty, SomeOddBall, Brosiyeah, YaBoiMoh, Quackinsons, Jeanne [FreshLX](https://modrinth.com/user/FreshLX/resourcepacks) 提供原始動畫！ [Traben](https://modrinth.com/user/Traben) 提供初始動態眼睛功能！ [Ithan](https://modrinth.com/user/IthanMendoza) 與 [TrasTick](https://modrinth.com/user/TrasTick) 讓實作變得更加順利，並新增多種眼型！
相容性 運作完全無礙的模組/資源包：playerAnimator、Better Combat、EmoteCraft、Quark、3D 皮膚層、Parcool、Not Enough Animations、First-person Model 無法運作的模組/資源包：Improved Animations、Serious Player Animations、除 emf+etf 外的其他 CEM 模型模組
